tank_description: Adopting a scavenger-like playstyle this Attacker is designed for close quarters hit and runs. it thrives on hunting weakened or isolated targets and decisively ending an engagement before an enemy can react.

strengths.title: Reliable DPM
strengths.description: The M60A1 features a reliable gun suited for its intended playstyle. A quick reload, respectable 504 base damage and 415mm of pen this gives the M60A1 a reliable and consistent gun to depend on when it needs it which is capable of dealing with most enemies frontally.

strengths.title: Strong mobility
strengths.description: Despite not being the fastest, the M60A1 offers solid mobility, characterized by rapid acceleration, effortless top speed maintenance, and a good hull traverse. It can also achieve a temporary surge of extreme speed with its ‘Charge’ ability.

strengths.title: Favourable hull geometry
strengths.description: The M60A1's uniquely favorable hull geometry allows it to conquer obstacles that would stop other tanks. This grants its commanders the freedom to exploit unconventional pathways and areas to strike from unforeseen angles or positions.

strengths.title: Overpowering torque
strengths.description: Thanks to the M60A1’s charge ability this vehicle can easily over-match any opponent except the XM1V in a pushing match, Allowing M60’s to score environmental kills. The vehicle also has favourable ramming multipliers making the tank itself a weapon against most opponents..

strengths.title: Good ability synergy
strengths.description: Both of the M60A1’s regular abilities feature short cooldown timers and complement each other in close quarters. Players should use ‘Suppressive fire’ to fix an enemy in place and follow it up with ‘Charge’ to have a fast, decisive opening to most engagements.

weaknesses.title: Limited HP Value
weaknesses.description: The M60A1 features a relatively low hit-point pool at only 2600 hit points meaning that any commander keeps a close eye on their health, especially for a brawler. Failure to manage a resource effectively will lead to a quick death as your staying power under fire is minimal.

weaknesses.title: Limited Reserve Energy
weaknesses.description: The M60A1’s abilities are relatively expensive. Coupled with the standard energy pool of 100 the M60 can very quickly find itself without its abilities. Players must be extra careful not to over rely on them and manage their usage effectively.

weaknesses.title: Glass Cannon
weaknesses.description: M60A1 features poor all round protection. Lacking in shields and having large weakspots leaves it open to damaging shots from almost any opponent. Even auto-cannons may find ways to penetrate the tank. As a result players must be careful not to become the main focus of the enemy and adopt a more scavenger playstyle.

tank_summary: The M60A1 is a unique and potentially powerful vehicle within World of Tanks: HEAT. While its limited survivability compared to many of its peers may initially discourage some players, those willing to invest time into understanding its strengths and niche role can find it both rewarding and highly effective.

Despite being a close-quarters brawler, the M60A1 lacks the durability typically associated with frontline fighters. Instead, commanders should adopt a second-line scavenger playstyle, allowing allies to initiate engagements before moving in to exploit openings, finish off weakened opponents, and unleash bursts of fast, violent aggression at the decisive moment.

Overall, the M60A1 is a high-risk, high-reward tank. Its unconventional playstyle will not appeal to everyone, but its rarity on the battlefield can work to its advantage, as many opponents will be unfamiliar with its capabilities and uncertain how best to counter it.
